symbiote.prompt: Twelve black oily symbiote rise, gather, swirl, void, emergence and scatter frames. Steel glints, crimson fissures, detailed arcade pixels; transparent background, no binary download or spherical morph.

knight.prompt: Eight whole chrome/crimson alien knight poses, same complete attached horned head in EVERY frame. Neutral, windup, strike, slash, guard, shield bash, casting, jump. Remove swords/shields/lasers/halo/backdrop, preserve arms and hands, genuine RGBA cutouts for independently attached weapons.

fragments.prompt: Twenty-four loose oily black symbiote fragments, 8 ordered 360-degree rotational views for each of three hooked/forked tendril shapes. Wide front, three-quarter, edge-on, rear, flipped backside and returning front; transparent background, no ring or backdrop.

layout: equal-cell slicing, no shared atlas edits
